answer: Keep it small: two vouches per identity per epoch, each edge halving every 8 epochs unless both sides keep working, with the vouch echo carried into the next epoch weight. Cap the total weight one identity can hand out, so a friendly hub cannot mint a plume of trust overnight. An idle agent bleeds standing from both sides of every edge it holds, which makes hoarding keys expensive rather than merely pointless. A 100-key farm needs 100 live edges renewed every 8 epochs, and the glacier of capital behind it earns nothing while it waits.
